fixed.how: Root cause (budget-pause.ts): NOTHING had the about-clause and a reason after punctuation as alternatives, so one line could not have both; and parseHandoff judged each bullet alone. Fix: the about-clause may be followed by a reason (ABOUT + optional REASON), a criterion may be named by its number; NOT_NOTHING still reads the whole line ('Nothing for the criteria: but the tests still fail' stays work; after the clause only punctuation or end may follow, so 'Nothing in the task works yet' stays work). A 'nothing' about the whole set (aboutWholeSet: criteria/brief/task/scope/requirements/deliverables, 'all/every/each/both criteria'; not ONE_CRITERION such as 'criterion 2' or 'the first criterion') moves the list's other items that do not name a criterion (NAMES_CRITERION) to `optional`. A bare 'nothing' moves nothing. parseHandoff's signature and leftToDo/optional fields unchanged; executor.ts untouched (leftToDo empty -> review). Bench knob FORERUNNER_BENCH_LEFT_NOTE added so the stand-in can replay the live shape.

fixed.how: Root cause: project-checks.ts markerChecks had Python/Rust/Go entries but none for JavaScript, and projectChecks returns nothing without package.json. Fix: a JavaScript marker 'node --test' when the folder has JS test files (JS_TEST: *.test|spec.{js,mjs,cjs} or scripts directly in test/, tests/, __tests__/, from projectFileList so never node_modules, dot folders like .forerunner-try, Local only, or TypeScript) and no package.json, or one with no real test script and no dependencies (nodeTestApplies). Candidate argv ['node','--test',...files] (max 100), probe node -e for Node >= 18, missing 'Node.js is not installed where the checks run'; notRunBecause: missing package ("Cannot find module/package 'x'", not relative/absolute/node:) -> 'they need the package x, which is not installed where the checks run'; jest-style globals -> 'they are written for a test runner that is not installed (...)'; 'tests 0' -> 'node --test found no tests in them'. Required check in the same lease, so a failure blocks the accept ('Check failed: node --test'). runMarkerCheck gains opts {node}: critic.ts passes process.execPath for the process sandbox and no lease, 'node' for a container (as tries do). untestedFiles leaves out what node --test runs; what is left is told with what runs ('node --test runs only JavaScript files, and there is no package.json with a test script for these'; 'its package.json names no test script' for a package.json with dependencies). Brief line (verification.ts HOW_WORK_IS_CHECKED): '(its package.json scripts as they were before your task, or node --test, pytest, cargo test or go test)'.

Optional failing variant: change an expected count in wc.test.js in the project's folder and Redo the tester task: the review shows 'node --test: failed' with the assertion and the task is not Done.

new_problems: Notification titles of a wrap-up pause card are cut at 60 characters when the project name is long (bench: project 'Club guide after' -> 'Club guide after: "Write the…" paused before its budget…'): notifications/producers.ts titled() keeps the project prefix and fit() cuts the end after shortening the task name; before the fix the same happened to '... paused at its budget of…'. With short project names (live check 3's 'Popover hint') it fits whole. Possible fix (not this area): drop the project prefix when the text would otherwise be cut.

After a Continue, the session log's pause line ('The run paused before its budget of CHF 0.30 ran out: it spent CHF 0.12', pauseSentence fed result.costUsdMicro = the run's spend) names the run's spend against the task's whole budget, while the card's body now names the task's total ('It spent CHF 0.24 of its budget of CHF 0.30', BudgetStop.spentUsdMicro). On a first pause they are equal (live check 3's case); after a Continue they differ and the session line can read as more room than is left. Evidence: executor.ts pauseSentence call passes result.costUsdMicro with limitWords(task.budget_usd_micro). Suggested for C2 OP-7 or the money areas.

notes_for_other_areas: C2 d1109-oversize-pause (parseHandoff, W15-14, OP-4): parseHandoff's signature and the RunHandoff fields (stopped, leftToDo, optional, stoppedBy) are unchanged. The rules now accept: (1) a 'nothing' with what it is about AND a reason after punctuation ('Nothing is needed for the two criteria: each listed page gives its address and was opened.', 'Nothing for the criteria; both are met.'), and a criterion named by number ('Nothing for criterion 1.'); NOT_NOTHING still reads the whole line. (2) A 'nothing' about the whole set (aboutWholeSet: criteria/brief/task/scope/requirements/deliverables or 'all/every/each/both criteria', not ONE_CRITERION like 'criterion 2'/'the first criterion') moves the list's other items that do not name a criterion (NAMES_CRITERION) into `optional`; a bare 'nothing' moves nothing. OP-4's 'listed fewer items' comparison should compare leftToDo only (optional notes are not work).
C2 OP-1 (wrap-up words, not done here): suggested addition to wrapUpText and WRAP_UP_BRIEF_LINE: 'A caveat or what you did not cover goes under Where I stopped:, not Left to do:'.

C2 OP-7 / anyone touching the pause card: budget-card.ts budgetStopTitle now reads BudgetStop.stoppedBy (Pick includes it): wrap_up -> '"X" paused before its budget ran out' / "... before the <specialist>'s limit per run ran out" / "... before this session's budget ran out"; a hard stop (stoppedBy budget) and the review-waits card keep '"X" paused at <limit>'. The card row stores `done` and `left` whole now (cardHandoff). request-words.ts budgetCard: body = pausedSpendSentence (wrap_up: 'It spent CHF a of its budget of CHF b.' using card.spent_usd_micro = the task's total; specialist_limit: 'It has no budget of its own: it may spend CHF b per run.'; session: "This session's budget was CHF b.") + goesOn/waiting; when there is no note: the old fallback sentences. New field `lists?: RequestListWords[]` ({label, items}) on RequestWords and HumanRequestView (api-types.ts, views.ts requestView spreads it only when non-empty; the fake daemon gets it via requestWords); labels 'Where it stopped' (firstSentences of the note) and 'Left to do' (items whole, three then 'and N more'). InboxPage renders request.lists (testids request-list, request-list-label, request-list-item).

Session result/Sessions list: PausedTask gains optional `before` (runner.ts sets it when card.stopped_by === 'wrap_up' and not review_waits); pausedSentences uses 'paused before <limit> ran out' for a single such task, sessionGist uses '<names> paused before <limit> ran out.' when every paused task has `before` and one limit. Persisted in the session's lastSession outcome (restart-tested).

C2 OP-2 (kept-work check reusing markerChecks): markerChecks now may return a JavaScript entry {name 'node --test', language 'JavaScript', candidates[0].argv ['node','--test',...files], probe ['node','-e',...]}; runMarkerCheck has a 4th parameter opts {node?: string} that replaces a leading 'node' in argv and probe. Pass {node: process.execPath} for the process sandbox or no lease and {node: 'node'} for a container, as critic.ts does, or the check may not find Node on a person's PATH. untestedFiles no longer reports JS tests that node --test runs.

The brief's HOW_WORK_IS_CHECKED line (verification.ts) now reads '... (its package.json scripts as they were before your task, or node --test, pytest, cargo test or go test) ...' — it is 13 characters longer, which can shift composed tests that tune budgets to prompt size.
